import json
from pathlib import Path
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
from btc_predictor.research.btc019_empirical import _database_url_from_environment

engine = create_engine(_database_url_from_environment(), connect_args={'connect_timeout':10})
out={}
with engine.connect() as c:
    assert c.execute(text("SELECT current_setting('default_transaction_read_only')")).scalar_one()=='on'
    assert c.execute(text("SELECT current_setting('transaction_read_only')")).scalar_one()=='on'
    out['read_only']='on'
    rows=c.execute(text("""SELECT exchange, symbol, timeframe, provider, count(*), count(DISTINCT timestamp), min(timestamp), max(timestamp)
        FROM raw.btc_ohlcv WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2020-01-01' AND timestamp < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01'
        GROUP BY exchange,symbol,timeframe,provider ORDER BY exchange,symbol,timeframe,provider""")).all()
    out['ohlcv']=[list(r) for r in rows]
    gaps=c.execute(text("""WITH venues AS (SELECT DISTINCT exchange,symbol,provider FROM raw.btc_ohlcv WHERE timeframe='1h'
        AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2020-01-01' AND timestamp < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01'),
        missing AS (SELECT v.exchange,v.symbol,v.provider,g.t FROM venues v CROSS JOIN generate_series(
        TIMESTAMPTZ '2020-01-01',TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-31 23:00',INTERVAL '1 hour') g(t)
        WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM raw.btc_ohlcv b WHERE b.exchange=v.exchange AND b.symbol=v.symbol
        AND b.provider=v.provider AND b.timeframe='1h' AND b.timestamp=g.t)),
        numbered AS (SELECT *,t-row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY exchange,symbol,provider ORDER BY t)*INTERVAL '1 hour' AS grp FROM missing)
        SELECT exchange,symbol,provider,min(t),max(t),count(*) FROM numbered GROUP BY exchange,symbol,provider,grp
        ORDER BY exchange,min(t)""")).all()
    out['gaps']=[list(r) for r in gaps]
    out['december_2019']=[list(r) for r in c.execute(text("""SELECT exchange,count(*),min(timestamp),max(timestamp) FROM raw.btc_ohlcv
        WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2019-12-01' AND timestamp < TIMESTAMPTZ '2020-01-01' GROUP BY exchange ORDER BY exchange"""))]
    tables=[r[0] for r in c.execute(text("SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='raw' AND table_type='BASE TABLE' ORDER BY table_name"))]
    out['other_raw_counts']={t:c.execute(text(f'SELECT count(*) FROM raw."{t}"')).scalar_one() for t in tables if t!='btc_ohlcv'}
    cols=c.execute(text("""SELECT table_schema,table_name,column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('information_schema','pg_catalog')
        AND data_type IN ('timestamp with time zone','timestamp without time zone','date') ORDER BY table_schema,table_name,column_name""")).all()
    out['post_2025_time_columns']=[]
    for schema,table,col in cols:
        if any(w in table.lower() for w in ('trusted','acquisition','attestation','calendar')): continue
        # Only timestamp aggregates, including ingestion columns labelled as such.
        q=f'''SELECT count(*),min("{col}"),max("{col}") FROM "{schema}"."{table}" WHERE "{col}" >= '2026-01-01' '''
        r=c.execute(text(q)).one()
        if r[0]:out['post_2025_time_columns'].append([schema,table,col,*r])
    out['composite_observation_range']=[list(r) for r in c.execute(text("""SELECT count(*),min(observation_time),max(observation_time),min(available_at),max(available_at)
        FROM derived.btc_reference_composite WHERE available_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01'"""))]
engine.dispose()
Path('/tmp/rbt002-rereview/live_database.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,default=str,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(out,default=str,indent=2))

import ast,dataclasses,inspect,sys,textwrap,time
from pathlib import Path
from btc_predictor.research_backtest import coverage as co,input_census as ic
c=ic.discover_decision_path();objs={}
# Resolve live methods with descriptors preserved, including property getters.
for path in c.callables:
    parts=path.split('.');i=next(i for i in range(len(parts),0,-1) if '.'.join(parts[:i]) in sys.modules)
    obj=sys.modules['.'.join(parts[:i])]
    for part in parts[i:]:
        obj=inspect.getattr_static(obj,part)
        if isinstance(obj,(staticmethod,classmethod)):obj=obj.__func__
        if isinstance(obj,property):obj=obj.fget
    objs[path]=obj
assert all(ic.owner_path(o)==p for p,o in objs.items())
print('live functions',len(objs),'closures',[(p,o.__code__.co_freevars) for p,o in objs.items() if o.__code__.co_freevars],flush=True)
start=time.monotonic();passed=0
for path,f in objs.items():
    tree=ast.parse(textwrap.dedent(inspect.getsource(f)))
    node=tree.body[0];node.decorator_list=[]
    node.args.kwonlyargs.append(ast.arg(arg='independent_added_input',annotation=None));node.args.kw_defaults.append(ast.Constant(None))
    ast.fix_missing_locations(tree)
    namespace=dict(f.__globals__)
    # All census functions have no closure, checked above; no owner body is executed.
    if f.__code__.co_freevars:raise RuntimeError('closure needs separate fixture')
    exec(compile(tree,f.__code__.co_filename,'exec'),namespace)
    replacement=namespace[node.name]
    original_code=f.__code__;original_kw=f.__kwdefaults__
    f.__code__=replacement.__code__;f.__kwdefaults__=replacement.__kwdefaults__
    try:
        co.enumerate_input_surface()
    except co.InputSurfaceError as e:
        assert e.code=='UNCLASSIFIED_PARAMETER' and 'independent_added_input' in str(e),(path,e)
        passed+=1
    finally:f.__code__=original_code;f.__kwdefaults__=original_kw
    if passed%100==0:print('live signatures refused',passed,'seconds',round(time.monotonic()-start,1),flush=True)
print('live signatures refused',passed,flush=True)
